This problem may be solved by simulating the replication process. Let's keep a list of all replications that may be applied by the current step. Apply an arbitrary replication, after that update a list by adding/removing all suitable or now unsuitable replications touching all affected on current step servers. The list of replications may be kept in a "double-linked list" data structure, that allows to add and remove elements to/from the set and to extract an arbitrary element of the set in
